name: class-session-card
title: Class session card
description: A class you can book: date tile, time and length, coach, room and level, spots left with a fill bar, and a Book, Join waitlist or Cancel action.
docs: start and end are exact moments (a Date, a timestamp or an ISO string with its offset); timeZone is where the session takes place and every time on the card is written in it, locale is the language, and the length is worked out from the two. spots is how many places are left and capacity how many there are in all: together they write '3 spots left of 14' and fill a real progress bar named 'Spots taken' that is read as '11 of 14 spots taken'. An open session with no spots left turns into a full one, which says 'All 14 spots taken' in words of its own ('Class full' when it does not know its capacity). status is open, full, booked or cancelled: open shows Book (onBook), full shows Join waitlist (onWaitlist, falling back to onBook), booked shows a 'Booked' badge with a check and Cancel (onCancel), and cancelled mutes the card, strikes the title and the time through and drops the actions. Every handler may return a promise: the button keeps its focus and shows a spinner with aria-busy while it runs, a rejection shows an alert saying that nothing was changed (press the button again to retry), and each result is announced politely in a status region. The buttons are named with the class and its time, so a list of them is not a list of 'Book'. coach is a name or { name, image? } (initials stand in for a missing picture), room and level are plain words, headingLevel sets the title's level, and labels carries every word for translation.
